## Description

Expected money in for the next 30, 60 and 90 days from due instalments, open dues and booked visits at their fee, shown beside the last 90 days actual.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Figures are computed, not generated; any AI summary is labelled as a draft.
- [ ] **AC2.** Amounts are integer minor units per currency.
